newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin price up 14 cents to 14.43 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin price up 14 cents to 14.43 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose 14 cents to 14.43 ringgit ($5.76) a kg on Friday, following a sharp overnight rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"Fund managers were covering lots of offers after the LME closed very strongly," said a trader.
Bids totalled 309 tonnes against offers of 128 and final turnover was 204 tonnes on Friday, against 159 tonnes on Wednesday.
Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia, traders said.
The local premium against the LME narrowed to $15 from $50 on Wednesday.
The Kuala Lumpur tin market was closed on Thursday for a public holiday.
